image_prompt.text: A central stone castle keep and tower with battlements and a pitched tower roof, tall enough to be seen from anywhere in the map
Surrounding defensive stone walls with battlements enclosing the courtyard, broken by a main gate entrance under a stone archway
Cobblestone routes running in through the main gate and across the courtyard to the keep, threading between the houses so movement has an obvious grain
A few smaller medieval houses with wooden pitched roofs and doors, clustered as built-up ground inside the courtyard rather than scattered at random
The edge of the map around the outside of the fortification, hidden behind a ring of trees and foliage
Composed views across the cobbled courtyard to the castle tower, framed by the curtain wall and its battlements

notes: Stage A outcome None: the prompt describes a place and its architecture — castle, curtain wall, gate, houses, cobblestone, trees, stone and wood materials — with no game type, mode, objective or mechanic. 'Players could explore and fight in' is how the map would be used, not a described genre, so no-genre.md was loaded rather than inventing Action or Adventure.
Stage B: there is a space and players walk through it, so no SET.

would have asked: 'Sounds like an explorable place: a walled medieval fortification with a central castle keep and tower as the landmark you navigate by, cobbled routes running in through the gate and across the courtyard, a few pitched-roof houses inside the walls, a treeline hiding the map edge, and a couple of composed views back at the tower. Stone on the walls, wood on the roofs and doors. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?'

would have asked: do players go inside the keep or the houses, or are they solid from the outside? Built as exteriors only, which keeps it on the proven single-pass route; enterable interiors are possible but that build isn't ready yet, so say the word and I'll note it for when it is.

would have asked: do players walk the battlements and the wall-tops, or are the walls scenery you fight beneath? Built as one ground-level courtyard surface with the walls as structure; walkable wall-walks over the courtyard would be surfaces stacked above each other, which isn't a route that's ready yet.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?

'Configurable attributes for wall height, building count, and overall scale' is a build-parameter request, not a layout feature — no field in this handoff can carry it, and the scale band is a four-value enum, so 'medium-sized' is the only part of it that survives downstream.
'A few smaller buildings' is not a stated number, so no count is recorded; the wording is kept in the settlement-density text.
Material direction — stone for walls, wood for roofs and doors — is folded into the option text rather than emitted as its own pick.
layout_placement is empty: nothing the prompt asked for is an invisible volume, marker or trigger. No spawn point, pickups or teleporters were requested and none were added.
